fusions.name: Butting Charge
fusions.desc: Charges up to 6 tiles at an enemy and butts it, dealing 15 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Scree Slide Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks loose a boulder that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and bursts, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Planted Hooves
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Unshifting Footing
fusions.desc: Each time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once for a shield. Unfed, the stacks fade. Your armour also rises by 5%.
